description: Get trending entities with momentum scores, sorted most-trending first. Without a `group` it returns trending companies; pass `group` to get people, agencies, regions, industries, topics, or currencies. Trend scores rank WITHIN a group and are not comparable across groups (companies use a large positive scale, currencies a small signed one); higher means more trending. Costs ~1 credit.

group.description: Entity type filter. Omit to get trending companies (the default).

name: get_trending_entities
title: Get trending entities
